title: Cubic character of a sign sum
statement: Let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $a$ be the sum of its coordinates in $\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z$. With $\chi$ the character on $\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z$ sending $1$ to $\zeta=\exp(2\pi\mathrm{i}/3)$, one has $$\chi(a)=\prod_{i=1}^n\left(-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}x_i\,\mathrm{i}\right).$$
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the sign cube
